purpose: Behavioral implementation guidance for LibreOffice Calc table and range operations: sort selected ranges, insert or delete rows and columns, copy ranges, and clear contents while preserving the remaining cell data.

requirements.statement: If either condition over positions 12 or 8 evaluates false, no update occurs and execution halts without effect
Processing is skipped when the input range of formula cell pointers is empty
A listening context is initialized prior to traversing the formula cells
Each formula cell in the input range receives a request to cease broadcasting
The context discards any broadcast entries that no longer have active listeners
Shared references are conditionally decremented or specialized cleanup is triggered based on stored count values
Temporary span-related bookkeeping structures are finalized upon exit
Returns the difference between two 64-bit values stored at fixed offsets within the input object, divided by eight
Returns false for table indices greater than 9999
Caller receives an indication via output parameter that some action occurred
Adjusts row range bounds when initial range exceeds sheet limits
Skips deletion if no rows fall within existing sheet dimensions
Shifts cell contents up by row count when deleting from middle of sheet
Clears shifted region and updates formula references accordingly
Updates sheet dimension counters after successful deletions
Invalidates calculation caches and triggers recalculation sequence
Notifies registered listeners of structural changes
Swaps initial sheet indices when the first exceeds the second
Returns success without iteration when no selection mask is passed
Operation succeeds only when document contains at least one sheet
Inserted row range gets adjusted when starting position exceeds ending position
Returns without effect when either the first coordinate or eighth parameter exceed the value 9999
Delegates to internal routine when all position arguments are within 0 to 9999 inclusive
Increases the bulk broadcast mode nesting level associated with the object instance
The operation checks a global storage location to determine execution mode and selects between atomic and non-atomic update paths accordingly.
Returns early without modifying outputs when the provided count is zero or negative
Scans sequential indices starting from zero to determine selected table entries using a predicate check
Upon finding the first selected table entry, stores a derived value obtained via secondary query into the first output location
Associates the provided document handle with the context at initialization time
If the stack integrity check fails after execution, control transfers to an error routine.
Records the initial calculation enablement state from the document before modifying it
Saves the incoming document reference directly into the AutoCalcSwitch object for later restoration
Changes the live calculation flag inside the referenced ScDocument structure

title: Cleanroom behavioral specification for LibreOffice Calc table and range operations: sort selected ranges, insert or delete rows and columns, copy ranges, and clear contents while preserving the remaining cell data
